test_title: PYST 49: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

Her paintings are way better __then __her sketches.
solution:
The correct answer is:** than**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Than' **is a conjunction which is used to compare two things.

 
 
• **For example: **His handwriting is better than his presentation skills. 
 
 
 
• In this context, the word **"than"** is used as a** conjunction** to compare two things: her paintings and her sketches.
 
• More specifically, it is used to introduce the second element of the comparison, showing how one element ranks in relation to the other according to a certain criterion, in this case, perceived quality or skill ("better").
 
• The structure typically involves some form of a comparative adjective or adverb, as seen here with "better," which is the comparative form of "good" or "well."

Therefore, the correct sentence is: *Her paintings are way better **than**__ her sketches.*
